# DeepSeek Harness
English | 中文
DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI.
It is built on an **everything-is-a-plugin** architecture and powered by Cordis, whose design is des
cribed in _A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_.
Documentation: https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/

### Sync to another machine
Build the same upstream revision on each computer before installing external plugins. Local source c
hanges require their own cumulative patch; plugin configuration does not transfer source edits. Exte
rnal plugin sources and fixed Git commits belong to their maintained repositories. Share portable co
nfiguration and encrypted credentials through the configured private environment repository; keep ma
chine paths, devices, chat history and synchronization keys outside that snapshot.

## Development
Start with the development guide and architecture documentation.
`pnpm run dev:web` builds, serves, and rebuilds client bundles on source edits in one terminal, and
`make help` lists the matching Make targets for Web and Desktop; the guide's application commands se
ction owns the full table.
For agents, follow AGENTS.md.
